name: mirage
text: Already protected: the phone merges my changes setting by setting, and only a setting you yourself change on the phone overrides mine. It does not re-apply old values on its own. Two things to avoid: moving the Auto-bet or Bids slider on the phone rewrites the kinds and rules it owns (that counts as you changing them), and the Live bids slider does the same for live-bid quality. Leave those alone and the changes stay.
